Water_meter.label: Water meter
Water_meter.description: The uCIFI water meter measures water volume that was distributed through a water meter, in pulse count as well as in m3. It also detects anomalies in the water meter.

Cumulated_water_volume.label: Cumulated water volume
Cumulated_water_volume.description: Number of cubic meters of water distributed through the meter since last reset.

Cumulated_pulse_value.label: Cumulated pulse value
Cumulated_pulse_value.description: Cumulated number of pulses detected on the meter.

Pulse_ratio.label: Pulse ratio
Pulse_ratio.description: Ratio to calculate water volume from pulse value.

Minimum_flow_rate.label: Minimum flow rate
Minimum_flow_rate.description: Minimum flow rate since last metering value.

Maximum_flow_rate.label: Maximum flow rate
Maximum_flow_rate.description: Maximum flow rate since last metering value.

Leak_suspected.label: Leak suspected
Leak_suspected.description: Set to True if water leak is suspected.

Leak_detected.label: Leak detected
Leak_detected.description: Set to True if leak is detected.

Back_flow_detected.label: Back flow detected
Back_flow_detected.description: Set to True if water back flow is detected.

Blocked_meter.label: Blocked meter
Blocked_meter.description: Set to True if water meter is blocked.

Fraud_detected.label: Fraud detected
Fraud_detected.description: Set to True if fraud is detected.
